title: Could You Say That Again?
goal: Gauk miesto žemėlapį ir sužinok, kaip nueiti į kavinę. Chuck kalba labai greitai – drąsiai prašyk pakartoti, kalbėti lėčiau ar paraidžiui.

npc: Hey there! Welcome, welcome! What can I help you find today?
Hi there! Welcome to Maple Harbor! What can I do for you today?
Well, hello! Welcome to the Visitor Center! How can I help you?
Sure thing! Here's a map. We're right here, at the red star. Anywhere in particular you want to go?
Here you go! This is us, right here, on Main Street. Anywhere in particular you want to go?

Great choice! Go right out the door, two blocks to the bank, then left. It's on the right, across from the post office. Oh, and use the crosswalk, okay? People drive fast around here! Does that make sense?

Oh, am I talking too fast again? Sorry! Let me slow down. Okay. Turn right out the door. Go straight two blocks, to the bank. Turn left at the bank, onto Oak Avenue. Yes, the big one. You can't miss it! Got it?

Great! Quick quiz: which way do you turn at the bank?
